title: pasania wrayi
intro: Pasania wrayi, commonly known as the Philippine oak, is a tree species belonging to the family Lauraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Pasania wrayi include acting as an expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic, making it a potential natural remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Pasania wrayi include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
